Definition: properly, to be fresh, i.e. full (rosy, (figuratively) cheerful); to announce (glad news)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to bear news, bear tidings, publish, preach, show forth; 1a) (Piel); 1a1) to gladden with good news; 1a2) to bear news; 1a3) to announce (salvation) as good news, preach; 1b) (Hithpael) to receive good news
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
